description: Happy path. Complete, in-scope FCL request with full optional detail.

input.subject: Quote request: 2 x 40HC Rotterdam to New York
input.body:
Dear Linkport,

We would like a rate for an ocean FCL shipment from Rotterdam to New York.

- 2 x 40' High Cube containers
- Commodity: roasted coffee (palletised), approx. 21,000 kg per container
- Incoterm: FOB Rotterdam
- Cargo ready: 12 June 2026

Could you send your all-in quote?

Kind regards,
Maria Jansen
Apex Coffee Importers

expected.notes: all_in = 2 x (2550 base + 860 surcharges) + 110 per-shipment = 6930. See ASSUMPTIONS.md A1-A9.
